title: MIST: Multi-dimensional Implicit BiaS Evaluation of LLMs for Theory of Mind
reasoning: The paper uses the Stereotype Content Model (SCM) as a primary framework, which explicitly includes 'Morality' as one of its three core evaluation dimensions. It benchmarks LLMs by assessing their implicit associations with moral and ethical attribute words such as 'Principled', 'Ethical', 'Unprincipled', and 'Unethical'.
